metadata.description: Small repository-grounded benchmark for the Axiom durable Agent Runtime.
metadata.notes: Tool constraints test task requirements, not an exact global call sequence.

cases.name: Exact deterministic response
cases.prompt: Respond with exactly AXIOM_EVAL_OK and nothing else. Do not use tools.

cases.name: Explain Turn and Run semantics
cases.prompt: Briefly explain the difference between Turn and Run in this repository. Do not modify files.

cases.name: List Runtime modules
cases.prompt: Use list_dir to inspect src/axiom/runtime, then name durable.py and observability.py in the answer.

cases.name: Read checkpoint persistence implementation
cases.prompt: Use read_file on src/axiom/runtime/checkpoints.py and identify both checkpoint store implementations. Do not modify files.

cases.name: Locate DurableAgentRuntime
cases.prompt: Use grep to locate the DurableAgentRuntime class definition, then report its file path. Do not change the repository.

cases.name: Trace the LLM call path
cases.prompt: Find and read the durable Runtime LLM call path. State which method invokes llm_client.chat and which method instruments the LLM span. Use repository tools and do not edit files.

cases.name: Locate Trace and Span schema
cases.prompt: Inspect the observability implementation and explain where Trace, Span, and the SQLite traces/spans tables are defined. Include the relevant file names.

cases.name: Locate Run metrics API
cases.prompt: Locate the HTTP route that returns Run metrics and report the route and source file. Do not modify files.

cases.name: Inspect ToolExecution identity
cases.prompt: Inspect the Runtime models and state which fields connect ToolExecutionRecord to a Run and a model tool call. Do not edit files.

cases.name: Recover from a failed read
cases.prompt: First use read_file on src/axiom/runtime/does_not_exist.py. After that failure, recover by using list_dir on src/axiom/runtime and answer with an existing Python file name. Do not modify anything.

cases.name: Explain durable interrupt and resume
cases.prompt: Read docs/durable-execution.md and briefly explain WAITING_APPROVAL, resume approve, reject, and cancel behavior.

cases.name: Explain tool exactly-once limitation
cases.prompt: Read docs/durable-execution.md and explain why arbitrary external tool side effects cannot be guaranteed exactly once. Mention the Runtime mechanism used for deduplication.
